create_cpu_gptq_config: create a CPUGPTQConfig instance to configure 4-bit GPTQ quantization for Intel CPU with AMX support
get_supported_act_dtypes: get the supported activation dtypes for CPUGPTQConfig returning torch half and bfloat16
get_quant_method: get the appropriate quantization method for a given layer using CPUGPTQConfig get_quant_method
create_gptq_linear_weights: create quantized 4-bit linear layer weights with qweight qzeros scales and g_idx parameters using GPTQLinearIntelAMXMethod
apply_gptq_linear: apply int4_scaled_mm_cpu to perform quantized linear matrix multiplication on Intel CPU with AMX
